## **📌 IF Quantification (5 and 10 micromolar)**
```{r box, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
# Load necessary library
library(ggplot2)

# Create the dataset in the same style
data <- data.frame(
  Group        = rep(c("CX", "Dox", "Veh"), each = 2),
  Concentration = rep(c("5", "10"), times = 3),
  Value        = c(5.3, 9.4,   # CX
                   96.8, 97.9, # Dox
                   3.7, 3.7)   # Veh
)

# Ensure the order of groups and concentrations
data$Group <- factor(data$Group, levels = c("Veh", "CX", "Dox"))
data$Concentration <- factor(data$Concentration, levels = c("5", "10"))

# Create the side-by-side bar chart (no error bars)
ggplot(data, aes(x = Concentration, y = Value, fill = Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Cell viability at 5 and 10",
       x = "Concentration",
       y = "Value") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")
```
